engine: ComfyUI 0.41 LoadAudio (folder_paths.filter_files_content_types) in the Comfyui-Studio image
environment: Episode 04 review GUIs for audio results (T-A10)
symptom: Review workflows pinned the FLAC results via a LoadAudio node; GET /object_info/LoadAudio listed none of the 31 pinned files (0 of 31), so the pinned widget value was 'not in list' in the UI. A first check also miscounted because the input spec is ['COMBO', {options}] and len('COMBO') == 5.
root_cause: Inside the container mimetypes.guess_type('a.flac') is (None, None); the content-type filter therefore drops .flac from the combo while .wav passes ('audio/x-wav').
fix_or_workaround: Pin 48 kHz WAV copies (ComfyUI/input/04-milk-and-mom-T-A10-<label>-<sha12>.wav) instead of FLAC; verify every review GUI's pinned name is in the LoadAudio options list (31/31 after the fix).
prevention: Any result pin for audio must be WAV; a publish step must read /object_info/LoadAudio options (spec[1]['options']) and fail when a pinned name is missing.
verification: Script in the T-A10 session: 'review GUIs with pin NOT in combo: 0'.
